page.title: Racial Signature Turrets
page.descr: Texts related to the Racial Signature Turrets Mod
page.t: Since the Split has realized that they were lacking firepower on Capital Ships, they started to adapt their small turret designs for larger vessels and adapted their plasma cannons to burst shotgun rows instead of pure energy.
Boron have found a purpose in having a powerful arc turret on their capital ships, so they made some adaptation on their existing large design.
Long range engagement could have benefited the Boron large vessel, and as such, they made it so.
Paranid have developed a powerful blast mortar turret for their large vessels, providing devastating firepower at medium range.

Since the Split has realized that they were lacking firepower on Capital Ships, they started to adapt their small turret designs for larger vessels and adapted their plasma cannons to burst shotgun rows instead of pure energy.
Regarding the increasing firepower on rival faction capital ships, the Teladi have improved the size of the Muon Blaster Turret to ensure their large vessels remain competitive in battle.
